City of London Corporation CEO Ian Thomas Named Most Influential Black Briton

01 Nov 2026, 10:53 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Business Desk · Source: www.bbc.co.uk

Recognition of Leadership

Ian Thomas, the chief executive of the City of London Corporation, has been named the most influential Black Briton on the 2027 Black Powerlist. This annual recognition highlights individuals of African and Caribbean heritage who have achieved significant leadership roles and broken through systemic barriers within their respective fields.

Thomas, 57, made history in 2022 when he became the first Black person to lead the City of London Corporation—the administrative body governing London's central financial district—in its more than 900-year history.

Professional Background and Public Service

Thomas brings over 30 years of experience in local government to his current position. His career trajectory and professional accomplishments include:

  • City of London Corporation: As CEO, he oversees approximately 5,000 staff, the City of London Police, and the management of 11,000 acres of open spaces, including Hampstead Heath and Epping Forest.
  • Local Governance: Previously served as chief executive of the Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames, where he led a £1.2bn regeneration initiative.
  • Public Service Record: Appointed a CBE in the 2019 New Year Honours for his work transforming children's services at Rotherham Metropolitan Borough Council.

Thomas, born in Sheffield to parents who arrived in the UK as part of the Windrush generation, has credited his upbringing and his parents' work ethic for shaping his professional approach.

2027 Powerlist Highlights

The Black Powerlist, now in its 21st year, aims to provide visibility to high-achieving individuals to inspire future generations. Beyond Thomas, the 2027 list features several notable figures across diverse industries:

  • Comfort Ero: President and CEO of the International Crisis Group, ranked second on the list.
  • Sir Lenny Henry: Awarded the Lifetime Achievement award for his foundational work with Comic Relief.
  • Notable mentions: Entrepreneurs Emma Grede and Steven Bartlett, as well as filmmaker Sir Idris Elba, were included in the top ten.

Verification

The full list of honorees and details regarding the selection criteria for the 2027 Black Powerlist are available through the official Black Powerlist organization’s publications. Readers interested in verifying specific rankings or the mission of the initiative can consult the organization's public reports or press releases associated with the 2027 awards cycle.
